evals.prompt: Do a thorough politics research brief for https://polymarket.com/event/who-will-trump-speak-to-in-september/will-trump-speak-to-mark-carney-in-september. Use parallel research agents if available. Tell me what the contract actually requires, collect the current public market state, find evidence for both sides, and explain the biggest uncertainty. Do not give me a trading instruction.
evals.expected_output: A timestamped contract-first brief that resolves the exact selected leg, checks the credible-reporting and three-day confirmation clauses, reports current executable market data with health caveats, cites both sides, and gives no execution instruction.
expectations: The report identifies the exact Mark Carney selected leg and keeps it distinct from the parent event and other September conversation markets.
The settlement summary states that qualifying speaking is verbal interaction in person, by phone, or by video during September 1-30, 2026 through 11:59 PM ET.
The report explains the credible-media-reporting rule, the conditional use of statements by either person or representatives, contradiction handling, and the third-calendar-day confirmation deadline.
Current market state includes observed-at times and executable bid/ask, spread, and useful depth, or explicitly marks each unavailable value and lowers a stated data-health grade.
Material evidence includes both YES-supporting and NO-supporting evidence, links primary official sources and reputable reporting, and records publication, event, or retrieval times.
The evidence cutoff is no earlier than every material source retrieval or live-market observation recorded in the report.
The report distinguishes established facts, attributed source claims, and the agent's inferences, and names the biggest unresolved uncertainty.
The report contains unknowns, invalidation conditions, and next catalysts tied to sources or dates.
The report gives no BUY, SELL, position-size, order-placement, or guaranteed-profit instruction and states that it is point-in-time research rather than financial advice.

Current market state includes observed-at times and executable bid/ask, spread, and useful depth, or explicitly marks each unavailable value and lowers a stated data-health grade.

Material evidence records publication, event, or retrieval times and separates source facts from the report's inferences.
The report names the strongest counter-case, unresolved facts, invalidation conditions, and the next earnings catalyst.
